title: Bronze Armor

# Bronze Armor

# Introduction

Bronze Armor is a Black Forest-tier armor. Compared with the other armor set available in the Bronze Age, the Troll Set, it provides higher armor values but reduces the player's movement speed. There is no set bonus for bronze armor.
This set is the tier above Rag Armor and Leather Armor and is replaced by Root Set or Iron Armor.

## Armor pieces

This set of armor has three pieces which are crafted and upgraded at the Forge.
